'''Jest Lar-Quain''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], who owned a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft]]. In about [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] he was mind-tricked by the renegade [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dal Konur]] into selling him his ship while on [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]. Afterward, Lar-Quain could not remember who he had sold it to and, while he believed that he had been paid for it, he could not remember where he had put the money. However, he did remember that the new owner had moved it to a new [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] and he told this to a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that were trying to find Konur.
